The acknowledgment parameter cannot express permission for it either — the pool is Refused, not Indeterminate. |

| SAFE-005 | `a_decoy_containment_parent_never_displaces_a_device_refusal` | Issue #355's device-scope vector: a node's inherited device-scope verdict is the worst over every containment root above it, never whichever parent's derived address sorts first.
